title: Twilio regional API domain removal
description: Twilio states that region-specific API domains stop working on April 28, 2026 and directs applications to api.twilio.com.
oldBehavior: The application addresses a Twilio regional API domain.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct literal api.ie1.twilio.com reference with api.twilio.com and review the resulting request behavior.
Keep dynamic URL construction and other regional domains under human review.

evidenceSources.summary: Official Twilio changelog identifies api.ie1.twilio.com as deprecated and api.twilio.com as the replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official Twilio changelog. The executable transformation is limited to direct string literals containing one explicitly reviewed regional domain.

assumptions: The official source establishes the domain replacement but does not establish a package or SDK version range.
Only the explicitly listed regional domain is covered by this transformation; other regional domains require separate review.
A generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
